a close-up photo of a cooked dish
a photo of an appetizing meal centered in the frame
non_food_penalty_prompts: a photo of a restaurant exterior building or signboard
a photo of an empty restaurant interior with tables and chairs
a photo of a paper menu filled with text

a photo of people posing without food visible
a photo of a logo or graphic design without food
